attacks.name: Shards of the Seraphim
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Pierce|: Change one of the defender's |!critical|, |!wild|, or |!block| results to a Blank.

attacks.name: Fangs of Farallah
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
If this attack deals |!damage|, after this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§poison§Poison| special condition.

attacks.name: Astral Strike
steps: The defender does not add |!critical| results in its defense roll to its total successes and cannot add additional dice to its defense roll as a result of |!critical| results.
If this attack deals |!damage|, after this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§stagger§Stagger| special condition.

superPowers.name: Mists of Hoggoth
superPowers.body: Place this character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per turn.

superPowers.name: Winds of Watoomb
superPowers.body: When this character is targeted by an attack, it may use this superpower. Push the attacker Toward this character |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Keeper of the Eye of Agamotto
superPowers.body: When this character is making a defense or dodge roll, it may reroll up to 2 of its defense or dodge dice.|\|Additionally, during the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|.

superPowers.name: Martial Artist
superPowers.body: When this character is defending against a |!physical| or |!energy| attack, if the attacker is within |!range| 2, this character adds Blanks in its defense roll to its total successes.
